screen.alkahest.journal.page.0:
Introduction

This journal is a guide to the early Alkahest build. Research and hypotheses are still in development. Use the arrows to turn pages.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.1:
Cauldron

Craft it with copper, a cauldron and stone. Place fire, a lit campfire, lava or magma beneath it, then fill it with a water bucket.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.2:
Brewing

Use ingredients on the cauldron or throw them into the water from above. It holds 6 items. Use an empty hand or wand to brew. Sneak-use empty-handed to retrieve ingredients. Heated water alone becomes salt after 20 seconds.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.3:
Cauldron recipes

Coal + bottle = purified water. 2 flowers + food = paste. Blaze powder + redstone = fire dust. Spider eye + cactus = caustic slime.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.4:
Distillation

Craft a distillery from 6 copper ingots, 2 glass and a furnace. Use organic material on it to start a one-minute run. Use an empty hand to collect crystals or ash.
screen.alkahest.journal.page.5:
Reagents

Right-click slime with fire dust in the inventory for napalm, or gunpowder with caustic slime for an acid bomb. Throw them with right-click. They can hurt you too!
screen.alkahest.journal.page.6:
Essences

A monocle reveals item essences. Craft a wand from a stick and a primal crystal to activate the cauldron 100 times. Salt ore generates in new chunks at Y 45–75.
